notes.title: New Update! Soccer Ball and Ship Added. 31.01.2019
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34247556/3031bad90af07e5e35eab1ff68c4618d59e39624.png[/img]

Now you can play with a soccer ball in winterland and summerland.

There are simple goalposts in two maps too. 2 in winterland. 1 in summerland.

A yacht added in summerland.Enter the yacht and steer the yacht.When you want to walk again and play with ball.Just press Esc and click play again button.




[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34247556/78e0fc623f6d1449b4e95fef23d1cde746a25c0f.png[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34247556/30ba18b1bd2f9ed73d9ddf61bdd0856f0aa94e70.png[/img]

notes.title: Future Plans 23.01.2019
notes.content:
[b]Car goes to the beach in 1- 2 minutes.This time should be longer.This means car area will be bigger [/b]

[b]Winterland has not enjoyable activities. I wonder your thoughts.What can we add?[/b]

[b]Exactly beach should develop.[/b]

[b]Car Simulation Area[/b]

Car driving added but not in winter map.Because of mountains of wintermap.

Near of the game starting point, you can see gate for car simulation.

Car simulation goes to the beach.

I hope you like game.
